summary: Frontend-only testing of Resource Library page (/resources) with 'Luminous Precision' theme. All features tested and working correctly: page loads with new dark theme, category filters work, search functionality works, preview modal opens with Brightluxx branding, download form captures lead info, Knowledge Base guides link correctly, and bottom CTA section renders properly.

features_tested.details: Page loads with 'Luminous Precision' theme - dark background (#050508), cyan accents, glassmorphism cards
All 5 filters work correctly: All Resources (28), Spec Packs (12), Cheat Sheets (4), BIM/CAD (4), Knowledge Base (8)
Search filters resources by title, description, and tags. Tested with 'pixel' (3 results), 'outdoor' (6 results), 'retail' (3 results)

Cards display with color-coded category previews: cyan for spec packs, emerald for cheat sheets, purple for BIM/CAD, amber for guides. Brightluxx branding ('BL' logo and 'BRIGHTLUXX' text) visible on all cards
Preview button opens modal with mock PDF preview showing Brightluxx branding, document title, category label, description, tags, and Download Full PDF button
Download button shows form with name and email fields. Form accepts input correctly. Submit button and cancel button work properly
8 Knowledge Base guide cards link to respective pages (e.g., /knowledge/cob-vs-mip-vs-smd)
CTA section renders with 'Need Something Specific?' heading and links to For Architects (/for-architects), For Contractors (/value-engineering), Contact Us (/contact)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Resource Library page (/resources) has been fully tested with 'Luminous Precision' theme. All interactive elements work: category filters, search, preview modal, download form with lead capture, and Knowledge Base guide links. The page displays 28 resources with color-coded previews and Brightluxx branding throughout.
